messages.subject: Urgent - potential braking issue on the CV-7 / need advice
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We've identified what looks like a software-related braking issue on the CV-7. Engineering has reproduced it on the test track and traced it to a firmware build. No accidents that we know of, but it affects stopping distance in wet conditions and I'm told it's potentially safety-related.

We need your help urgently - on whether we have to notify the DVSA, on a recall, and on our exposure. The board meets next week. Can we speak first thing tomorrow?

Daniel

—
Calderwell Mobility Limited
Pioneer House, Trafford Park, Manchester M17 1WA

messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Yes - let's speak at 8.30am. Tom Gallagher will lead day to day with me. Ahead of the call: please don't circulate the engineering findings widely, mark everything 'privileged - prepared for legal advice', and route the technical work through us where you can so we protect privilege.

On a first read this sounds like it will be a safety-related defect requiring prompt DVSA notification, but let's confirm the engineering position before we conclude that.

Sarah

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
